title: 2-Digit Subtraction Without Regrouping Worksheets
intro: Use tens and ones to teach subtraction without regrouping.
html:
Teaching notes for parents and teachers

How to teach it

Build the starting number, then remove the required ones and tens. Match each action to its column in the written calculation.

Example to work through together

Use the model below as you explain the example. Have your student point to the quantities as you discuss them.

Start with 58: 5 tens and 8 ones.

Remove 23: 2 tens and 3 ones.

8 − 3 = 5 ones
5 − 2 = 3 tens
58 − 23 = 35

Ask your student

Why can we subtract the ones without exchanging a ten?

If your student needs help

If the student subtracts mismatched places, have them label each column and rebuild the number.
